correctness.rationale: Continuum origin-started sluggish diffusion with alpha>=0, mu=1/(alpha+2)∈(0,1/2], independent Exp(r) resets r>0. The exact free occupation fraction Y has Lamperti Stieltjes G_mu(q,k)=((q-k)^(mu-1)+q^(mu-1))/((q-k)^mu+q^mu) for q>max(k,0). Conditioning on first reset yields an exact renewal equation for moment generating M_k(T); rG_mu(s+r,k)=1 has a unique positive-tilt root because the Laplace transform is strictly decreasing and diverges at its lower boundary. Exponential renewal tilting plus nonarithmetic key renewal theorem establishes psi(k) growth. Implicit differentiation yields analytic strictly convex psi; symmetry psi(k)=k+psi(-k), gradient limits 0,1 and exponential tightness (compact [0,1]) yield the full LDP and Legendre rate. As k→∞ psi(k)=k-r+C k^{-mu/(1-mu)} with C=r^(1/(1-mu)), Legendre inf yields cusp r-r mu^-mu(1-mu)^(mu-1)delta^mu; Lamperti variance (1-mu)/4 yields central curvature r/(1-mu). Param z=(s+r-k)/(s+r) algebraically solves root. Independently checked 30 (mu,r,z) renewal-root pairs and the mu=1/2 Brownian closed form. Numerical comparisons are not proof of LDP or endpoint asymptotic.

value.rationale: The fractional Lamperti family interpolates between Brownian and increasingly sluggish diffusion. Exact rare occupation-edge delta^mu behavior, including coefficient, reveals information invisible in the existing Gaussian central limit and gives a usable full rate for fluctuation calculations. The specific non-Brownian exponent is a natural physically interpretable boundary invariant.

limitations: General renewal-LDP mechanism and Brownian specialization are prior results.
Only origin-started continuum symmetric process and independent Poisson resets.
No uniform finite-time error, microscopic lattice or threshold-reset LDP.
